Anchor R&D interactive terminal — vendored static asset (Wave 7)
================================================================

WHAT THIS IS
  anchor-term.js + anchor-term.css are a LIGHTWEIGHT, dependency-free,
  terminal-style console component authored for Anchor. They render the
  server-sent-events (SSE) output stream of a persistent stream-json REPL
  session, provide a command input line that POSTs user turns, surface in-session
  gates (AskUserQuestion) inline, and offer the exit -> discover -> confirm-adopt
  flow.

WHY NOT xterm.js
  The frozen design (planning/rnd-v2/MASTER-PLAN.md §E + Constraints) permits
  vendoring xterm.js as a static asset IF obtainable offline, OR a lightweight
  dependency-free terminal-style console as an explicitly-allowed alternative.
  A copy of xterm.js DOES exist on this machine under unrelated node_modules
  trees, but it was deliberately NOT vendored here:
    - xterm.js is a raw terminal EMULATOR; it provides no command-input line, no
      inline gate prompts, and no adopt flow — all of which a REPL chrome must add
      on top anyway. The net code saved would be small while adding a large,
      version-coupled bundle.
    - Anchor's rule is stdlib-only at runtime with no native/compiled assets;
      keeping the client asset small + self-contained matches that spirit and
      avoids pinning a third-party version.
  The component is NAMED "anchor-term" and exposes a single factory
  (window.AnchorTerm.mount) so a real xterm.js adapter can be swapped in behind
  the same API later without touching callers.

SERVED AT
  /vendor/anchor-term/anchor-term.js
  /vendor/anchor-term/anchor-term.css
  (read-only static route in anchor_gui.py, traversal-safe, mirroring the
   vendored-KaTeX pattern.)
